headline: Foreclosure auctions
hit a *6-year high*
slides.sub: The busiest quarter since early 2020, and the seventh straight quarter of annual gains.
slides.fig_caption: Completed foreclosure auctions, Q3 2026 vs. a year earlier

slides.label: consecutive quarters of year-over-year increases
slides.body: Q3 2026 posted the highest quarterly total of completed foreclosure auctions since Q1 2020.

slides.label: of Q3 auctions involved loans made in *2022 or later*
slides.body: The first wave of higher-rate, post-pandemic mortgages is now working its way through the default pipeline.

slides.title: Year-over-year change in *completed auctions*
slides.note: 31 states saw increases. And scheduled auctions are up *31% YoY for November*, so the pipeline is still filling.

slides.title: Normalization, *not a crash*
slides.body: Volume is still below pre-pandemic levels. But more distressed inventory means more deals for investor clients, and more homeowners who need a smart exit before auction day.
